text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And now… for the final stretch!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I have arrived at the steep peak that is 3,600 meters!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: If I win today's race… I might as well be a stayer, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This will mean I've completely dominated the Bakushin Road, right?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: 3,600 meters is no obstacle for me anymore, I'll run it clean!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is that a quirk of yours, Trainer? Thank you for the reassuring nod!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Today is the day a stayer with immense speed shall be born!
